metadata.evidence: Fresh managed Maya 2024 completed the same cylinder, joints, skinCluster, bulk parent=1 initialization, one source skinPercent query, and cmds.objExists(mesh) before planner execution.

Fresh launched managed Maya 2024 PID 17012 exited while running the stub-selector planner diagnostic. The smoke excluded cmds.polySelect through pure-Python selector/group-builder stubs but still passed the MFnMesh captured before skinCluster history insertion into build_skirt_parent_plan. Operation exceeded 45 seconds, health probe was refused with WinError 10061, and cleanup confirmed managed_pid_already_exited. Combined with 036l PASS, this proves the healthy fixture becomes unsafe only after planner work even without polySelect, and makes stale pre-skin MFnMesh lifetime across skinCluster insertion the strongest next A/B hypothesis.

metadata.purpose: A/B the stale-function-set hypothesis. Build the same fixture, but after skinCluster creation and bulk initialization resolve a brand-new MSelectionList/MFnMesh from the visible mesh and pass that fresh post-skin mesh_fn into build_skirt_parent_plan with the same pure-Python selector/group-builder stubs. Then query one source weight and probe mesh existence.
acceptance: Fast-forward AIMayaTool main and include smoke commit 9922bd8135fff5331569c150323c3de1e1cccefd or later.
Use a newly launched healthy managed Maya 2024 session with startup_timeout=90 and operation_timeout=45; force a fresh unsaved scene and do not save or quit Maya.

Use the pre-skin MFnMesh only to derive the original root_loop before history insertion. After skinCluster creation and bulk weight initialization, resolve a new MSelectionList and new MFnMesh from mesh and pass only that fresh post-skin MFnMesh to build_skirt_parent_plan.
Keep selector and group_builder pure-Python stubs so cmds.polySelect remains excluded.
After planning, query the parent/source weight on the first assignment component and then only call cmds.objExists(mesh).

If PASS, classify stale pre-skin MFnMesh lifetime across skinCluster/history insertion as the root cause candidate and patch fixtures/production callers to avoid carrying MFnMesh across history mutation, then re-run full workflow. If FAIL on a fresh session, continue planner-core substep isolation because fresh function-set resolution does not cure the crash.
